disclaimer: This is an educational simulation, not emergency guidance. FloodGuard is a simplified teaching game. Its water levels, outcomes and scores are invented and are not a flood forecast or a real-world plan. Characters are fictional and AI-generated text can be wrong. If you are in a real emergency or a flood is happening near you, stop playing and call 112 (India emergency number). Follow instructions from your local authorities and official sources for your area (for example the India Meteorological Department, the Central Water Commission and your State Disaster Management Authority). Do not rely on this game for decisions about evacuation, safety or health.
